explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/767. g_k(n) is the maximum number of edges of an n-vertex graph containing no cycle with k chords incident to one vertex of the cycle. HasCycleWithIncidentChords encodes this: a cycle through v and k distinct f i with s(v, f i) a chord of the cycle. Pósa proved g₁(n) = 2n − 4 for n ≥ 4. The statement matches. Faithful.
